annotations.annotation_text: The Russian wartime mycotoxin is a neurotoxic bioweapon that permanently damaged Case's central nervous system as punishment for embezzling from his former employers, exiling him from cyberspace to 'the meat'.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 6.
Bukatman, Scott. Terminal Identity. Duke UP, 1993.

annotations.annotation_text: New Yen (¥) reflects 1980s economic anxieties regarding Japanese financial ascendancy and transnational zaibatsu hegemony, dominating the black-market underworld of Chiba City.
sources: Tatsumi, Takayuki. Full Metal Apache. Duke UP, 2006.

annotations.target_phrase: Biz here was a constant subliminal hum
annotations.annotation_text: The ethos of Night City as an unmitigated social-Darwinist marketplace where economic transactions ('biz') constitute the sole measure of survival and human worth.
sources: McCaffery, Larry. Storming the Reality Studio. Duke UP, 1991.
